Name: Larky's Strawberry Cows
Author: larkylovesyou2
Description:
[color=#d4d4d8]Are you in need of some cute pastel cows in your life? Well, here you go! This mod adds a new Strawberry Cow, which can be purchased from Marnie's once you build your first barn. It also adds several cooking recipes to utilize your new supply of Strawberry Milk![/color]

[size=4][b]:: Features ::[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Strawberry cows can be milked for Strawberry Milk. Strawberry Milk can be turned into Strawberry Cheese using the Cheese Press, or it can be used in various new cooking recipes.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Adds 7 new recipes: Strawberry Matcha, Strawberry Latte, Strawberry Milk Bun, Strawberry Muffin, Strawberry Milkshake, Strawberry Cheesecake, and Fruit Sandwich. All of these recipes can be crafted using either Strawberry Milk or Strawberry Cheese.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Strawberry Cows aren't your only source of milk! You can cook Strawberry Milk using one strawberry and one of any type of milk.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]If you're not interested in pretty pink cows and would rather just have the cooking recipes, there's a separate version that contains just that![/color][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]:: Credits ::[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Shoutout to AngoraDuchess's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23644]Strawberry Cows[/url] mod! I didn't reference their mod at all (I started mine before I thought to check if anyone had already done this), but I thought it was worth mentioning! I intend to make a fork of this mod later that is compatible with their cows instead.[/color][/*]
[/list][b][size=4]:: Recipes ::[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Strawberry Milk: [/b]1 Milk (Any) & 1 Strawberry[/*]
[*][b]Strawberry Matcha:[/b] 1 Strawberry Milk & 1 Green Tea[/*]
[*][b]Strawberry Latte:[/b] 1 Strawberry Milk & 1 Coffee[/*]
[*][b]Strawberry Milk Bun:[/b] 1 Strawberry Milk, 1 Sugar, 1 Wheat Flour, & 1 Egg (Any)[/*]
[*][b]Strawberry Milkshake:[/b] 1 Strawberry Milk & 1 Sugar[/*]
[*][b]Strawberry Cheesecake:[/b] 1 Strawberry Cheese, 1 Egg (Any), 2 Strawberries, & 1 Sugar[/*]
[*][b]Fruit Sandwich:[/b] 1 Bread, 1 Jelly, 1 Strawberry Cheese, & 1 Banana[/*]
[/list]
